name: All Heathens Leave Skeletons
description: **Only matters with "Former Villagers Keep Aging Among the Heathens" or "Heathen Tribe Ages, Dies and Has Children" ticked**: in the normal game a Heathen never ages, so never dies of old age. Every Heathen who dies of old age leaves a skeleton like any villager: your believers bury it with "Burying the dead" (once The Buried Mausoleum is solved), which gives a normal grave. A puzzle Heathen's skeleton is no longer that puzzle's Heathen: the new one is. **Cannot be ticked with "Former Villagers Among the Heathens Leave Skeletons"**: ticking one unticks the other. The Death record says how they died; **Heathens never count in the Village Statistics.**
behavior_changes: While this file is shipped, VVFP Heathen Aging.dll lets every Heathen who dies of old age leave a body (SetHealth 0x4758B0(0, 2)) for the believers' burial; a puzzle Heathen's body gets role 0.
explicit_non_changes: Nothing happens unless a Heathen aging row is ticked: in the stock game no Heathen dies of old age.
